operation.body:
## Goal
Add a bounded in-memory schema-v1 JSONL envelope reader to DiscoveryCore, implementing the approved R-001 version rejection and incomplete-session recovery rules. Retain complete records without treating a truncated or malformed session as complete.

## Acceptance criteria
- Accept Data only; no file reads, CLI input mode, hardware calls, persistence, network, dependencies or native source changes.
- Reject incompatible schema versions explicitly, enforce existing 64 KiB record and 8 MiB session bounds before parsing, and retain only newline-terminated, valid JSON object records.
- Validate session/type/sequence/monotonic elapsed-time envelopes and session-end frame-count/completeness. Return a valid prefix plus bounded typed incompleteness reason on malformed/truncated input; never skip a bad line and resume as if continuous.
- Preserve raw complete record bytes as evidence; do not certify observation payloads, source authenticity or physical safety. Unknown record types and invalid envelopes stop recovery. Document envelope-only scope and absence of telemetry-value validation.
- Add synthetic regression cases for current demo round trip, zero frames, version mismatch, malformed/truncated JSONL, session mixing, sequence/time/end inconsistencies and bounds. Run existing product and adapter checks, integrated review and remote CI.
- Update development/specification docs to state this incremental capability and remaining work. Hand off one PR with human review for input-validation changes; auto-merge only if eligible under project policy.

## Constraints
Parent Project #1, authorized by the current local execute-project self-correcting-review auto-merge invocation. Existing project low-risk-only merge rule and mandatory security review remain. Implement the already owner-approved R-001 reader design (Project #1 decision 6879220276); no new security/privacy posture or input-facing CLI/file boundary. Preserve private workflow, historical data and unrelated .gitlab/ files. All validation synthetic only. Risks: boolean/numeric bridging, incorrectly labeling truncated data complete, resource bounds and interpreting envelope acceptance as full report validation. Decision queue: no material choice required; full payload decoding and CLI file access remain separate future goals.

## Out of scope
Live telemetry, hardware tests, native/SMC calls, privileges, workloads, report persistence, scheduler, CLI read command, full observation decoding, source authentication, GUI/control/recovery, dependencies/toolchain installs, background automation or a second goal.

## Relevant context
docs/discovery-specification.md (approved schema-v1 reader and truncated-line rules); docs/development.md; .ai/docs/project-requirements.md; .ai/project/; Sources/DiscoveryCore/DemoReport.swift. Goal #11 completed in owner-merged PR #12, main 0243ade989d31f0a39258c94874a77a4df7d9d8c, CI run 43609037184 green. Bootstrap and R-001 approved; fixture correctness does not certify Monterey/device behavior. Rollback: reviewed forward revert PR, no persistent data or service.
